name: AppHeader
description: Global top bar with brand, primary navigation (Services, Book, Stylists, Journal), and user menu.

name: BrandLogo
description: Fringe wordmark at the left of the header.

name: PrimaryNav
description: Horizontal navigation links with active underline on Book.

name: UserMenu
description: Compact user greeting and avatar button on the right side of the header.

name: LeftSidebarNav
description: Beige intake sidebar showing 9-step progress with selectable steps and the current step highlighted.

name: StepList
description: Vertical list of steps (01 Service through 09 Confirm) with bullets, dividers, and the active '07 Estimate' state.

name: ContentArea
description: Main white content column containing the estimate intro, selected options summary, and a disclaimer.

name: EstimateIntroBlock
description: Section header with chapter label and large 'Your Estimate' title followed by descriptive subtext.

name: SelectionSummaryList
description: Stacked summary of chosen options (Service, Color Level, Length, Add‑ons, Condition) each with label, value, subtle divider, and 'edit' link.

name: DisclaimerBanner
description: Butter-tinted notice about potential adjustments to the final quote in-salon.

name: RightEstimatePanel
description: Butter accent panel summarizing the estimated price, time, price range, and action buttons.

name: EstimateAmountHero
description: Large currency figure ($245) with small caption 'Estimated — USD' and duration line below.

name: PriceRangeList
description: Three-row list showing Low, Likely, and High amounts with horizontal dividers and right-aligned prices.

name: ActionButtons
description: Primary black 'Continue to Booking' CTA and secondary 'Adjust' button.
